claim: A severe Binance BTCUSDT perpetual capitulation state observed just after a funding settlement transfers to a positive 90-minute Coinbase BTC-USD spot reversal large enough to survive Coinbase execution costs.
signal_venue: Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perpetual and Binance BTCUSDT spot public archives
execution_venue: Coinbase Advanced BTC-USD spot public candles

decision.funding_event: each actual Binance settled funding calc_time
decision.entry_time: funding calc_time plus 10 minutes, using the Coinbase five-minute candle open

signal.basis_definition: log(Binance perpetual completed 30m close / Binance spot completed 30m close)
signal.perp_taker_sell_ratio_definition: 1 - taker_buy_base_volume / volume on the completed Binance perpetual 30m bar ending at funding time
signal.spot_taker_buy_ratio_definition: taker_buy_base_volume / volume on the completed Binance spot 30m bar ending at funding time
signal.btc_return_60m_definition: Binance spot completed close at funding time / completed close 60 minutes earlier - 1

coinbase_transfer_and_execution.indicator_cutoff: only Coinbase candles closed by decision_time
coinbase_transfer_and_execution.spot_failure_stop: decision-time 12-bar volume-weighted close minus one decision-time ATR
coinbase_transfer_and_execution.stop_fill: minimum of bar open and breached stop level
coinbase_transfer_and_execution.target_fill: maximum of bar open and target level
coinbase_transfer_and_execution.time_stop_fill: Coinbase candle open exactly 90 minutes after entry

position_and_costs.cost_note: Primary fee assumption is the repository Coinbase configuration; actual account tier may differ, but it may not rescue a failed primary test.
position_and_costs.cost_application: subtract round-trip cost from each executed trade return before multiplying by the 5% capital fraction

holdout_policy: Run development first. If any gate fails, keep internal validation and final holdout locked. Do not alter thresholds, remove conditions, change venue/product, change holding period, lower costs, invert the signal, or select a nearby variant on consumed data.
